summary_en: 194,500 ordinary shares cancelled effective 26 June 2026, representing 2.2% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury). Post-cancellation issued shares outstanding (ex-treasury) 8,365,014; treasury holdings 240,986 shares.
title_en: Notice of completion of cancellation of treasury shares
translation_en_brief: NADEX Co., Ltd. completed the cancellation of 194,500 ordinary shares on 26 June 2026, pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act (会社法第178条). The cancellation was resolved by the board on 9 December 2025. The 194,500 shares cancelled represent 2.2% of the shares outstanding (calculated as 194,500 ÷ 8,365,014 ex-treasury shares). Following the cancellation, issued shares outstanding (excluding treasury) total 8,365,014, and treasury holdings stand at 240,986 shares (excluding 425,400 shares held in the J-ESOP trust account with Japan Mastertrust Bank).
